reviews.text: I think it's the only place where they truly give my dog ​​a really good brushing.
Thank you Aaron and Jennifer for entrusting Nacho to us and for being part of the Tails.Co family!
They did an excellent job bathing and stripping my Fox Terrier. Gustavo was super friendly.
Maps says they open at 10, but I want to schedule an appointment to take my dog. I call and they don't answer... That's where the customer experience begins.
Incredible service and experts in the field
Excellent service. It's worth every penny.

Fantastic place!!!
They gave my Airedale Terrier the perfect breed cut. And all done by hand!!!
The guys who serve you are lovely and explain really well what they're going to do to your dog!
Without a doubt, this is the place I'll always take my dog!!!

Excellent service, the staff are very friendly, and the way they treat your dog is incredible. They leave happy, which is really important, and even more adorable than you'd expect, with their perfectly rounded tails despite their shaved paws. They ask if your dog needs any special care, especially for their eyes, and follow all the instructions to the letter. They're ready to go quickly; they don't keep you waiting. Thank you so much! I highly recommend this service. Go for it!

Today we got a bath and a haircut! I always leave this place happy; the care they give the dogs and the attention from everyone is incredible. Plus, Chispa is very nervous, but here she lets them do everything without any problem.
Thanks, Tails!

Excellent place! The groomer was super attentive to my little one. We watched from a reasonable distance, and he really did a great job. Her haircut was beautiful; she left very calm and looked gorgeous. Definitely an excellent place for our furry friends!
They're always super nice and take great care of my dog. I'm happy with the service.
My Floki is so happy!! The hand stripping was wonderful!
I loved how they did my little one; it's hard to find places that do hand stripping and know how to care for each dog's coat. Very attentive and professional. Highly recommended! 👌🏻 …
Amazing place! They always leave my dog ​​looking perfect, smelling great, and he always comes back very calm. The staff is always willing to provide the best service and answer any questions.

I've been taking my dog ​​there for years. But this is the third time they've overcharged me. Either for treatments I didn't ask for or because of her weight; this time it was because she's older and it costs more to bathe her. But they never warn me in time. It's always when I ask why the bill is so high. And then the "details" come up in the itemized bill. It's true that they then offer to charge less, which is what they should actually charge. But it's an attempt to scam me, and I'm not going to allow it anymore. Also, this is the third time they haven't trimmed her nails because "she won't let them." It's a shame I can no longer count on you for my dog's baths, which, by the way, aren't cheap at their regular price.

Beware! They're scamming people here. My mom took her dog to get bathed, and from the moment she dropped her off, they wouldn't tell her the price. They just took her straight into the bath, and only when they were already bathing her did they tell her the price was based on weight and age. In the end, they charged her $700 pesos just for a bath and a trim ($450 for the "senior" bath and $250 for the trim). A rip-off!

They don't tell you the price; they say it's by weight, and then they say it's because your dog is a senior and could have a heart attack. The heat is terrible right now, and they gave my dog ​​a bath while it was still wet. 700 pesos is a rip-off! I've been to better places that charge 400 for everything.
